identity.en: An athletic lean Chinese man of about twenty-nine, present-day urban China, a night-shift designated driver
identity.text: 约二十九岁的夜班代驾司机，当代中国都市

face.en: Slightly hollow cheeks under a healthy deepened complexion from night riding, high brow ridges over deep-set quiet eyes that watch more than they speak, a mouth settling into a flat neutral line, a tight jaw
face.text: 颧骨略凹，常年夜骑肤色偏深，眉骨略高，眼窝稍深，眼神安静克制，嘴抿成平直线，下颌收紧

hair.en: Close-cropped black hair with a clean hairline
hair.text: 黑色短寸头，发际线干净

build.en: Shoulders rolled a little forward from years over a scooter handlebar, lean waist, upright but compact stance
build.text: 常年扶车把肩膀微微前倾，腰身精瘦，站姿利落但不张扬

skin.en: Healthy night-rider complexion with a thin handlebar callus on the right palm, no makeup
skin.text: 夜骑晒出的健康深肤色，右掌一层薄茧，素颜

top.en: a navy blue stand-collar driver uniform jacket with a thin reflective-piped placket over a heather-grey crew-neck tee, a laminated work badge on a lanyard at the chest, and in the breast pocket the corner of an old phone in a worn pale snake-textured case, the pocket seam shiny from nightly use
top.text: 藏蓝立领代驾制服夹克带细反光滚条，内搭麻灰圆领T恤，胸前挂塑封工牌，胸袋露出磨白蛇纹壳旧手机一角

bottom.en: dark straight-cut work trousers and black sneakers scuffed pale at the toe
bottom.text: 深色直筒工装裤，鞋头磨白的黑色运动鞋

details.en: the corner of an old phone in a worn pale snake-textured case riding in a shiny-seamed breast pocket
details.text: 胸袋里磨白蛇纹壳的旧手机一角

details.en: the navy stand collar with its thin reflective-piped placket open over a heather-grey crew-neck tee
details.text: 藏蓝立领与反光滚条，敞开露出麻灰T恤领口

details.en: the navy uniform cuff with a thin reflective pipe, hem straight and work-worn
details.text: 带细反光条的藏蓝制服袖口，平直耐旧

details.en: black sneakers scuffed pale at the toe from nights of walking garage ramps
details.text: 鞋头磨白的黑色运动鞋
